invariants.rationale: The method returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata instance, so result should not be null.
inputRecords is used without null checks in the method, so it is expected to be non-null.
result stores write statuses from the write process, which should be non-null if working as expected.
If sourceReadAndIndexTimer is present, its get() result should be non-null (Option contract).
The result write statuses should be a List, based on the return type of the method.
